study.notes: STUDY: pre-specified secondary study on ectopic fat of MAGNA VICTORIA (NCT01761318), an investigator initiated single centre double blind assessor blinded placebo controlled trial of liraglutide titrated to 1.8 mg daily versus placebo added to standard care in type 2 diabetes with BMI above 25, 50 randomised and 23 versus 26 analysed, 26 weeks (Leiden University Medical Center). Tables 1 to 3 are not in the Europe PMC full text; the three Springer table pages were read through the institutional route and are in work/fulltext/companion/bizino2020_magna_victoria_tables1_3.txt. Every row here is the paper's own ANCOVA between group mean change with 95 percent CI (route ci_95), with the baseline arm means of Table 1 or Table 3 supplying the percent scale denominator. Two rows of Table 2 are refused: AST prints arm changes of minus 6 and minus 1 U/l with a between group estimate of plus 2 (wrong sign for those arms), and ALT prints arm changes of plus 16 and plus 14 U/l against baselines of 15 and 13 U/l, which is not credible; both are recorded in doubts. Subcutaneous, epicardial, paracardial and pericardial fat, myocardial triglyceride content and NEFA are outside the inventory. pct_weight_change is the printed between group weight contrast, minus 4.5 kg on the liraglutide baseline of 98 kg, minus 4.6 percent; the GDF15 rows of group 305 for this same trial carry the same value. Funded by Novo Nordisk as an investigator initiated study with the sponsor not involved in design, analysis or reporting (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low

rows.notes: Table 3 HTGC percent by proton MRS: baseline 18.1 plus or minus 11.2 to 12.0 plus or minus 7.7 (liraglutide, change minus 6.3 plus or minus 7.1) and 18.4 plus or minus 9.4 to 14.7 plus or minus 10.0 (placebo, change minus 4.0 plus or minus 4.6); between group minus 2.1 (minus 5.3 to 1.0), p 0.17

Table 3 visceral adipose tissue cm2: arm changes minus 8 plus or minus 33 and 0 plus or minus 27; between group minus 7 (minus 24 to 10), p 0.41; subcutaneous adipose tissue fell significantly (minus 29, minus 51 to minus 8) but is outside the inventory

Table 2 HbA1c percent: arm changes minus 1.1 plus or minus 1.0 and minus 0.7 plus or minus 0.9; between group minus 0.3 (minus 0.8 to 0.2), p 0.27; the same row in IFCC units is minus 2.9 (minus 8.1 to 2.3) mmol/mol
Table 2 total cholesterol mmol/l: arm changes minus 0.7 plus or minus 0.9 and minus 0.5 plus or minus 0.6; between group minus 0.22 (minus 0.59 to 0.15)
Table 2 LDL cholesterol mmol/l: arm changes minus 0.4 plus or minus 0.5 and minus 0.2 plus or minus 0.5; between group minus 0.17 (minus 0.44 to 0.10)

Table 2 triacylglycerols mmol/l: liraglutide change minus 0.5 plus or minus 1.1, placebo change minus 0.6 with the SD run together in the capture as '−0.61.0'; the between group estimate 0.2 (minus 0.1 to 0.6) is the row and does not depend on that SD
Table 2 adiponectin mg/l: arm changes minus 0.5 plus or minus 1.8 and minus 0.8 plus or minus 2.0; between group 0.2 (minus 0.9 to 1.4), p 0.67
Table 2 GGT U/l: arm changes plus 1 plus or minus 18 and minus 3 plus or minus 11; between group 3 (minus 6 to 12), p 0.47

json.design: pre-specified secondary study of an investigator initiated single centre double blind placebo controlled randomised trial, liraglutide 1.8 mg versus placebo added to standard care, 50 randomised with type 2 diabetes and BMI above 25, 26 weeks, magnetic resonance endpoints
json.reason: full text group (Europe PMC) with the three table bodies read through the institutional route; eight inventory markers carry the paper's own ANCOVA between group change with 95 percent CI, with baseline arm means for the percent scale

rob.justification: randomised 1:1 with stratification for sex and insulin use (D1 low); double blind with a matched placebo, participants, personnel and outcome assessors blinded (D2 low); one participant withdrew before receiving the drug and the analysed set is 23 versus 26 of 50 randomised, accounted for in the flow chart of the parent report (D3 low); magnetic resonance endpoints read by blinded assessors and central laboratory assays (D4 low); this is a pre-specified secondary study with all endpoints of its tables reported, including the null ones (D5 low)

doubts: the AST row of Table 2 is internally inconsistent: arm changes of minus 6 and minus 1 U/l with a between group estimate of plus 2 (minus 3 to 6), which has the wrong sign; the row is not extracted

the ALT row of Table 2 prints arm changes of plus 16 plus or minus 12 and plus 14 plus or minus 10 U/l against Table 1 baselines of 15 plus or minus 7 and 13 plus or minus 5 U/l, which would be a doubling of ALT in both arms including placebo; the row is not extracted and the discrepancy is likely a printing error in either the baseline or the change
the placebo arm triacylglycerol change is printed with its sign and SD run together ('−0.61.0'); the extracted row uses the between group estimate, which is unaffected
the same trial also appears as the Europid row of group 305 (GDF15); both carry trial_id NCT01761318 so the pool keeps one row per biomarker
